title: Can You Decorate Your Wedding Limo? Tips & Rules
description: Can you decorate your wedding limo? Learn expert tips, decoration rules, and safety guidelines for wedding limo service in Anaheim & OC.

blocks.text: Check the Limo Company’s Decoration Policy First
Before purchasing decorations, always confirm the company’s rules.
blocks.html: Before purchasing decorations, always confirm the company’s rules.

blocks.text: Professional wedding transportation providers typically allow decorations, but they often have guidelines to protect the vehicle’s paint, windows, and interior.

blocks.text: Common policies include:

items: No adhesive tape directly on paint
No suction cups that could scratch windows
No tying items to mirrors or door handles
No confetti, glitter, or messy materials inside

blocks.text: What NOT to Do When Decorating a Wedding Limo
Even if you’re excited, avoid these common mistakes:
blocks.html: Even if you’re excited, avoid these common mistakes:

blocks.text: ❌ Using Duct Tape or Strong Adhesives
These can damage the paint and leave residue.

blocks.text: ❌ Hanging Items That Block the Driver’s View
Safety comes first. Decorations must not interfere with mirrors or windshield visibility.

blocks.text: ❌ Throwing Rice, Glitter, or Confetti Inside
These can permanently damage interior finishes and result in cleaning fees.
